ask: mkae a countdwn for presale and who buyin for who plz
sentence: Shows a live countdown to a ticket presale start time and tracks which person buys a ticket for which person, with a cap of four tickets per buyer.
use_when: A group is waiting on a ticket presale and wants a shared countdown
Friends need to sort out who buys tickets for whom
You want to see who in the chat still has no ticket covered
Buyers have a per-person ticket limit to split fairly
dont_use_when: Splitting the cost or paying back money after tickets are bought
Voting on which event or date to go to
Tracking a general to-do list or shared shopping list
